title: Chart Configuration Anatomy Explorer
description: A Chart.js 4.4.0 explorer that shows a live chart configuration as color-coded type, data and options blocks beside the chart it produces; each control rewrites one block, hovering a block outlines the chart features it controls, tooltips name the configuration path of every bar, point or slice, and a Break it button demonstrates a labels/values mismatch.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Chart.js
Data Visualization
Chart Configuration
Declarative Charts
publisher: MicroSims 2.0: Generating, Instrumenting and Evaluating Interactive Learning Objects with AI

educational.topic: The type, data and options parts of a Chart.js configuration
learningObjectives: The learner will explain which part of a chart configuration (type, data or options) controls each visible feature of a chart, by editing values and observing the result.

accessibility.notes: Configuration blocks are focusable; focusing a block triggers the same highlight as hovering; the caption is an aria-live region

controls.label: Break it / Fix it
controls.action: Remove or restore the last label to show a labels/values mismatch

hover: Hover a configuration block to outline the chart features it controls
Hover a chart element for a tooltip naming its configuration path

assumptions: Type and responsive changes rebuild the chart from the configuration object; data and legend edits call chart.update()
limitations: Tooltip callbacks and the highlight plugin are part of the real configuration but are summarized, not printed, in the options block

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore and explain: change one part, observe which chart features respond
keyQuestions: Which part of the configuration moves the legend?
Where does the color of the second bar come from?
What happens when labels and values disagree, and why?
commonMisconceptions: The chart type lives in options
Changing a dataset array redraws the chart without chart.update()
Labels and values are matched by name rather than by position
assessmentOpportunities: Name the configuration path for a given chart feature
Predict the effect of a labels/values mismatch for bar and pie charts
